_comment: Single source of the shell's sizes, radii and timings (px at scale 1, ms).
Current values are PLACEHOLDERS taken from the GNOME layer (docs/fenestra-shell/INVENTORY.md §8).
design/reference/measurements.json (tests/visual/measure.py) replaces them key by key:
a key there with reliable=true wins over the value here (tools/apply-measurements.py).

_sources.desktop.label.gamma: label coverage a -> a^(1/1.15): Windows' ClearType labels (solid/dark-100-01, dark-150-01) vs the bench (tests/window-frames/desk_boxes.py): pixels > 200 at 150 % 240/161/309 vs Windows 236/160/308, summed ink +8 %; at 100 % ink -4 % (1.0: -7 %)
_sources.desktop.label.font: Windows' icon title font (SystemParametersInfo SPI_GETICONTITLELOGFONT) is Segoe UI 9 pt; solid/dark-150-01 label glyph widths match Segoe UI at 18 px

_sources.taskbar.acrylic.tint.dark: WinUI AcrylicBackgroundFillColorBase (dark): Tint #202020, TintOpacity 0.5, TintLuminosityOpacity 0.96, Fallback #1C1C1C = taskbar.fill.dark measured in solid/ AND bloom/ dark-100-01-taskbar (identical: the GPU-less VM drew the fallback, so the shots cannot show the acrylic itself)
_sources.taskbar.acrylic.tint.light: WinUI AcrylicBackgroundFillColorBase (light): Tint #F3F3F3, TintOpacity 0, TintLuminosityOpacity 0.90, Fallback #EEEEEE = taskbar.fill.light
_sources.taskbar.acrylic.blur: WinUI AcrylicBrush BlurAmount 30 (Gaussian sigma, DIPs); noise 0.02 = AcrylicBrush noise opacity (own noise texture, not Microsoft's asset)
_sources.desktop.icon: bloom/dark-100-01-taskbar.png: Edge icon 48x48 at (24,131); solid/dark-150-01: 72x72 at (37,197)
_sources.desktop.cell.height: bloom/dark-100-01-taskbar.png: label tops 61 (Papelera) and 185 (Microsoft Edge) = 124 px row pitch; icon tops 7 and 131
_sources.desktop.cell.width: NOT MEASURED (no shot has a 2nd column): icon centre x = 48 at 100 % (72.5 at 150 %), so a column starting at x=0 is 96 wide; label limits agree ('Microsoft Edge' 81 px fits on one line, 'Papelera de reciclaje' ~107 px wraps)
_sources.desktop.label.gap: label glyph top = icon top + 54 (61 = 7 + 54, 185 = 131 + 54; 150 %: 88 = 7 + 81); gap tuned on tests/window-frames (device-pixel layout of ShadowLabel) so the glyph tops land there at 100 % and 150 %
_sources.desktop.label.shadow.blur: fit of solid/dark-100-01 and light-100-01 labels (white text on #1f1f1f): black, Gaussian sigma 1.6 px, offset (+0.5, +1), alpha = 1.7 x blurred coverage (clamped), rmse 1.5 levels
_sources.desktop.item.hover: NOT MEASURED (no hover/selection shot): Explorer ListView state colours (#E5F3FF hot, #CCE8FF / #99D1FF selected), translucent over the wallpaper
